summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Insurrica insurance landing page with 8 key updates. Backend API working well (71.4% success rate), most frontend features working correctly. Key critical features like navbar popup, product cards, partners section all working as expected.

minor_issues.issue: No server-side validation for empty/invalid fields
minor_issues.impact: Accepts empty data but frontend validation compensates

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile sticky CTA bar with 3 buttons not visible on mobile viewport (375x812)

integration_issues.issue: Product dropdown in navbar/product popups occasionally fails to select options (timeout issues)

passed_tests: ✅ CRITICAL: Navbar 'Get Free Quote' button opens popup form overlay (not scrolling to hero)
✅ Nav popup form has name, phone, product dropdown and submits successfully to POST /api/leads
✅ CRITICAL: Product cards are all equal size - uniform grid layout (no large/medium variations)
✅ All 7 product cards are clickable and open popup with pre-selected insurance type
✅ Partners section shows 16 insurance company logos with actual Clearbit images
✅ Testimonials show face photos (img elements, not just initial letters)
✅ Testimonials show age in format 'Name, Age'
✅ Floating WhatsApp and Call widgets visible on desktop (bottom-right)
✅ Page title is 'Insurrica | Compare Smarter. Insure Better.'
✅ Google Analytics placeholder script present in page source (G-XXXXXXXXXX)
✅ Meta Pixel placeholder script present in page source (XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX)
✅ Stats section counters work without flickering
✅ Footer shows Rahoul Agarwaal, Bengaluru contact, no IRDAI license text
✅ All sections render: hero, products, why-us, stats, partners, testimonials, FAQ, footer
✅ Backend POST /api/leads endpoint working for all insurance product types
✅ Desktop floating widgets are hidden on mobile viewport

critical_fixes_needed: Fix mobile CTA bar visibility - Mobile sticky CTA bar with 3 buttons (Get Quote, WhatsApp, Call) is not showing on mobile viewport despite code being present
Investigate CSS classes 'md:hidden' on mobile-cta-bar component - may need viewport detection fix
minor_improvements: Add server-side validation to POST /api/leads endpoint for better data integrity
Improve dropdown selection reliability in popup forms to prevent timeout issues
